selectors:
  - name: nightly
    description: Every finance or marketing model, with all its parents
    definition:
      union:
        - method: tag
          value: finance
          parents: true
        - method: tag
          value: marketing
          parents: true
  - name: finance_marts
    description: Finance models in the marts folder (intersection)
    definition:
      intersection:
        - method: tag
          value: finance
        - method: path
          value: models/marts
  - name: no_python
    description: Everything except the Python model
    definition:
      union:
        - method: fqn
          value: "*"
        - exclude:
            - method: fqn
              value: customer_segments

version: '1.0.0'
profile: jaffle_dbt                 # profile name in profiles.yml
require-dbt-version: [">=1.11.0", "<2.0.0"]

model-paths: ["models"]             # project keys use hyphens

test-paths: ["tests"]

sources:
  - name: jaffle_shop               # source('jaffle_shop', ...)
    description: Raw tables of the shop application
    schema: jaffle_shop             # default = the source name
    config:
      loaded_at_field: _loaded_at
      freshness:                    # inherited by every table
        warn_after: {count: 12, period: hour}
        error_after: {count: 24, period: hour}
    tables:
      - name: orders
        identifier: orders          # real table name, if different
        description: One row per order
        config:
          event_time: order_date    # for microbatch children and --sample
          freshness:                # merged with the source block
            warn_after: {count: 6, period: hour}
            filter: "_loaded_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'"
        columns:
          - name: id
            data_tests:
              - unique
              - not_null
      - name: customers
        config:
          freshness: null           # no freshness check here
      - name: order_items
        config:
          freshness: null
      - name: products
        config:
          freshness: null

blocks.text:
models:
  - name: fct_orders
    description: One row per order, with the amount paid
    config:
      group: finance
      access: public                # private | protected (default) | public
      tags: ['finance']
      event_time: order_date
    data_tests:                     # model-level test from dbt_utils
      - dbt_utils.expression_is_true:
          arguments:
            expression: "amount >= 0"
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: amount
        data_tests:
          - is_positive             # custom generic test (tests/generic)
  - name: fct_order_items
    description: One row per order line
    config:
      group: finance
      tags: ['finance']
      event_time: order_date        # read batch by batch by its microbatch child
  - name: fct_order_items_daily
    config:
      group: finance
      tags: ['finance']

blocks.text:
models:
  - name: dim_customers
    description: One row per customer
    latest_version: 2               # ref('dim_customers') -> v2
    config:
      group: marketing
      access: public
      tags: ['marketing']
      contract:
        enforced: true              # every column needs data_type
    constraints:                    # model-level constraint
      - type: check
        expression: "lifetime_value >= 0"
        name: lifetime_value_not_negative
    columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: integer
        constraints:
          - type: not_null
          - type: primary_key
      - name: first_name
        data_type: varchar
      - name: last_name
        data_type: varchar
      - name: email
        data_type: varchar
      - name: country
        data_type: varchar
      - name: region
        data_type: varchar
      - name: first_order_date
        data_type: date
      - name: most_recent_order_date
        data_type: date
      - name: number_of_orders
        data_type: bigint
      - name: lifetime_value
        data_type: decimal(38, 2)
    versions:
      - v: 1
        defined_in: dim_customers   # file dim_customers.sql
        deprecation_date: 2027-06-30
      - v: 2                        # file dim_customers_v2.sql (default name)
        columns:
          - include: all
            exclude: [first_name, last_name]
          - name: full_name
            data_type: varchar

unit_tests:
  - name: test_dim_customers_lifetime_value
    description: lifetime_value is the sum of the order amounts
    model: dim_customers
    versions:
      include: [2]
    given:
      - input: ref('stg_jaffle_shop__customers')
        rows:
          - {customer_id: 1, first_name: Ana, last_name: Diaz, country: France}
      - input: ref('fct_orders')
        format: csv
        rows: |
          order_id,customer_id,order_date,amount
          10,1,2025-03-01,5.00
          11,1,2025-04-01,7.50
      - input: ref('country_regions')
        rows:
          - {country: France, region: Europe}
    expect:
      rows:
        - {customer_id: 1, full_name: Ana Diaz, number_of_orders: 2, lifetime_value: 12.50}
  - name: test_fct_orders_only_new_rows
    model: fct_orders
    overrides:
      macros:
        is_incremental: true        # test the incremental branch
    given:
      - input: ref('int_orders__enriched')
        rows:
          - {order_id: 1, paid_amount: 5.00, loaded_at: '2025-06-01 00:00:00'}
          - {order_id: 2, paid_amount: 9.50, loaded_at: '2025-07-01 00:00:00'}
      - input: this                 # rows already in the table
        rows:
          - {order_id: 1, loaded_at: '2025-06-01 00:00:00'}
    expect:
      rows:
        - {order_id: 2, amount: 9.50}
  - name: test_int_orders__enriched_paid_amount
    model: int_orders__enriched
    given:
      - input: ref('stg_jaffle_shop__orders')
        rows:
          - {order_id: 7, customer_id: 1}
      - input: ref('stg_jaffle_shop__customers')
        rows:
          - {customer_id: 1, country: Morocco}
      - input: ref('int_payments__successful')
        format: sql                 # ephemeral input: sql format required
        rows: |
          select 7 as order_id, cast(3.00 as decimal(16, 2)) as amount
          union all
          select 7 as order_id, cast(4.50 as decimal(16, 2)) as amount
    expect:
      rows:
        - {order_id: 7, country: Morocco, paid_amount: 7.50}

with ranked as (
    select
        user_id,
        id as order_id,
        order_date,
        row_number() over (
            partition by user_id
            order by order_date desc, id desc
        ) as rn
    from jaffle_shop.orders
)
select user_id, order_id, order_date
from ranked
where rn = 1

select
    order_date,
    count(*) as orders_that_day,
    sum(count(*)) over (
        order by order_date
        rows between unbounded preceding and current row
    ) as running_orders,
    -- previous row = previous day WITH orders
    lag(count(*)) over (order by order_date) as orders_previous_row
from jaffle_shop.orders
group by order_date
order by order_date
